item.alternate_dimension.chicken_parmesa: A hearty meal! Grants regeneration when eaten.
item.alternate_dimension.portal_wand.des: Shift-right-click on one of your portals to remove the portal
Charge right-click for three seconds to warp back to your home point and create a portal to return to where you were.
item.alternate_dimension.sigma_notator.d: A powerful, explosive math weapon that shoots explosive term projectiles.
death.attack.math_damage.item: %1$s was caught cheating on %2$s's math test with %3$s
item.alternate_dimension.halloween_quest: I think this is the wrong type of disk...
item.alternate_dimension.seed_gun.descri: Requires Alternate Dimension seeds as ammo
item.alternate_dimension.beetle_sword.de: A powerful relic created by a mythril sword swallowed by the beetle queen, infusing it with beetle power.
death.attack.spike.player: %1$s was stabbed to death whilst trying to escape %2$s
death.attack.spike.item: %1$s was innards were pierced by %2$s using %3$s
item.alternate_dimension.golden_steak.de: The shiniest piece o' steak y'all've ever seen!
gui.alternate_dimension.planet_selector_: In Alternate Dimension, you pick the planet you start on. Each planet in the dimension has its own unique biomes, mobs, blocks, and challenges, and some are harder than others, but you will be able to access all of them later in the game.
item.alternate_dimension.mortar_and_pest: A primitive way to crush basic materials into powder and dust
Can only crush very weak materials; cannot crush ores or ingots.
Can be crushed by Mortar & Pestle
item.alternate_dimension.life_essence.de: The essence of living, natural creatures in tune with nature's rhythm.
item.alternate_dimension.fire_essence.de: The essence of infernal, magmatic creatures bent on chaos and destruction.
item.alternate_dimension.candy_essence.d: The essence of sweet, candied creatures who only want you to get off their frosting.
item.alternate_dimension.ice_essence.des: The essence of chilly, icy creatures with frozen hearts.
item.alternate_dimension.void_essence.de: The essence of dark, corrupted creatures intending to destroy this realm and the creatures that live within it.
item.alternate_dimension.hallowed_essenc: The essence of light, hallowed creatures with one intent: to purge this world of its two greatest threats: corrupted mobs and you.
item.alternate_dimension.omega_essence.d: An amalgam of the six primary essences. Represents a union of the six elements.
item.alternate_dimension.beetle_sword.de: Has a chance to summon a friendly beetle on hit.
Grants the wielder increased speed, agility, and armor.
block.alternate_dimension.the_dirt_block: Grants the ability to place unlimited amounts of dirt.
Its normal relative uselessness has been distorted by the magic of Eleroth, transforming it into this treasure.
A rare, powerful, enchanted block of dirt that is a result of the Overworld leaking into Eleroth.
item.alternate_dimension.miners_pet.desc: Increases your mining speed by 50% when held.
item.alternate_dimension.adventurers_pet: Increses movement speed by 50% and step height by 1 when held.
item.alternate_dimension.warriors_pet.de: Increases size by 25%, attack speed by 10%, and attack damage by 25% when held.
item.alternate_dimension.instatunnel.des: Blows out a huge sideways tunnel whilst keeping all the ores.
Extremely useful for beginner and veteran miners alike!
item.alternate_dimension.starcaller_scep: Right-Click to summon a long line of lightning strikes.
Grants the ability to fly while it is thundering.
A magical staff powered by lightning energy that wields the ability to summon the power of the heavens unto thine enemy.
item.alternate_dimension.bottled_sunligh: Use to change the time to day.
item.alternate_dimension.bottled_moonlig: Use to change the time to night.
item.alternate_dimension.instavator.desc: Extremely useful for beginner and veteran miners alike!
Blows out a huge vertical tunnel whilst keeping all the ores.
WARNING! Steve Mining Co. is not responsible for any fall damage casualties that result from the use of this item.
item.alternate_dimension.crude_salve.des: Use to heal 10 HP over 20 seconds.
item.alternate_dimension.dormant_mana_st: Use Magic Dust and Mana Crystals to reawaken it.
A mana stone that has lost its power with time or use.
item.alternate_dimension.wrench.descript: Used to configure most machine blocks.
item.alternate_dimension.position_card.d: Right-Click on a block to set the position to that block.
Left-Click in the air to set the position to your position.
item.alternate_dimension.mana_meter.desc: Right-Click on a block to display how much mana is contained within.
item.alternate_dimension.corrupted_flesh: May have side effects when fed to some mobs.
Magical bricks infused with highly potent astral power, rendering them unbreakable by normal means.
item.alternate_dimension.essence_pouch.d: A backpack dedicated to storing all your essences.
item.alternate_dimension.hunters_pouch.d: A specialized backpack dedicated to storing most natural mob drops. (excluding essences)
toasts.alternate_dimension.blue_moon_toa: Mobs become enchanted with starlight. Good Luck.
toasts.alternate_dimension.moon_event_en: The moon has returned to normal...
item.alternate_dimension.mini_instatunne: A cheaper, basic version of the real deal for starter miners to use.
Blows out a small sideways tunnel whilst keeping all the ores.
item.alternate_dimension.mini_instavator: A cheaper, basic version of the real deal for starter miners.
Blows out a small vertical tunnel whilst keeping all the ores.
WARNING! Steve Mining Co. is not responsible for any fall damage casualties that result from the use of this item.
item.alternate_dimension.fruit_pouch.des: A specialized backpack dedicated to storing all your various fruits.
item.alternate_dimension.storm_essence.d: The essence of rare, powerful, stormy creatures - products of thunderous weather mixed with magic.
item.alternate_dimension.portal_wand.des: Use while holding a Position Card to create a portal to the position in the card.
item.alternate_dimension.aluminum_storag: Right-Click on a Box to instantly upgrade it to an Aluminum Crate whilst keeping the contents intact.
item.alternate_dimension.math_essence.de: The essence of algebra and calculations, used to make an array of math-related weapons and materials.
item.alternate_dimension.math_workbook.d: A basic math workbook that shoots plus symbols to hurt enemies.
item.alternate_dimension.ore_essence.des: The essence of metals, gems, and crystals; basically anything found underground.
block.alternate_dimension.mystic_sapling: A dense condensation of magical and living energies, coalescing into this tree sapling.
Can grow into any of the smaller Alternate Dimension trees.
item.alternate_dimension.basic_goodie_ba: A simple goodie bag dropped from basic enemies. Contains basic loot.
item.alternate_dimension.enchanted_goodi: A magical goodie bag, usually containing an assortment of essences and magic dust.
item.alternate_dimension.verdant_goodie_: A bag that seems to breathe and live as a living being, filled with all the life-infused items you'll ever need.
item.alternate_dimension.frosty_goodie_b: An ice-cold bag that seems to be freezing to the touch, filled with cold, wintry items to freeze your foes.
item.alternate_dimension.metallic_goodie: A rock-hard pouch packed with valuable metals and gems from deep underground.
item.alternate_dimension.supersweet_good: A candy-lover's dream, filled as chock full of sweet treats as a well-stocked candy store.
item.alternate_dimension.gummy_goodie_ba: A squishy goodie bag filled with a delectable assortment of gelatin-formed buff-granting gummies.
item.alternate_dimension.infernal_goodie: A spicy bag that melts anything within. Except for the contained fire-and-brimstone items, that is.
item.alternate_dimension.umbral_goodie_b: A dark and mysterious goodie bag that always seems to absorb any light near it, shrouding the items within under permanent darkness.
item.alternate_dimension.angelic_goodie_: A righteous goodie bag filled to the brim with a plethora of blessed artifacts from the heavens.
item.alternate_dimension.enchanted_helme: It doesn't like to be worn...
But it can be used to summon small armor minions to aid you in battle!
item.alternate_dimension.raw_metalmeat.d: Extremely tough and chewy, but highly iron-rich!
item.alternate_dimension.cooked_metalmea: Melted a bit so its less tough and easier to eat, and gives more regen when eaten, but not the most nutritious!
item.alternate_dimension.mushroom_cataly: A mystic-infused mushroom amalgam that can be used to open a portal to another world...
item.alternate_dimension.mana_inserter.d: A tool used to manually insert mana into blocks that need it without having to set up mana providers.
Consumes Mana Crystals from your off-hand.
item.alternate_dimension.sun_idol.descri: Used to activate a portal to Solaria (BRING FIRE RESISTANCE!).
A conglomeration of fire and light energies, coalesced into this high-density core of light.
